% figure (2026-11-17): the three channels with one virtual scalar, after PHY 513 Lecture 21 slide 23 and PS p. 157; generated by qft-C/tools/l21/figs/make_figs.sh
\tikzset{
  fdl/.style={line width=0.8pt, black},
  fdx/.style={circle, fill=black, inner sep=0pt, minimum size=3.6pt},
  fdv/.style={circle, fill=figB, draw=figB, inner sep=0pt, minimum size=5pt},
  fdlab/.style={font=\scriptsize, inner sep=2.6pt},
  fdmom/.style={->, >=Stealth, figO, line width=0.6pt},
}
\tikzset{
  fda/.style={fdl, postaction={decorate}, decoration={markings, mark=at position 0.55 with {\arrow{Stealth[length=5pt]}}}},
  fdS/.style={font=\small},
}
\tikzset{
  fline/.style={line width=0.8pt, black, postaction={decorate}, decoration={markings, mark=at position 0.56 with {\arrow{Stealth[length=5.5pt, width=4.5pt]}}}},
  sline/.style={line width=0.8pt, black, dash pattern=on 3.5pt off 2.2pt},
  blob/.style={draw, line width=0.8pt, fill=figB!12},
}
\tikzset{
  pline/.style={line width=0.8pt, black, decorate, decoration={snake, amplitude=1.6pt, segment length=5.2pt}},
}
\begin{tikzpicture}[font=\small]
  % s-channel
  \begin{scope}
    \coordinate (a) at (0,-0.6); \coordinate (b) at (0,0.6);
    \draw[fdl] (-1.0,-1.6)--(a); \draw[fdl] (1.0,-1.6)--(a); \draw[fdl] (b)--(-1.0,1.6); \draw[fdl] (b)--(1.0,1.6);
    \draw[sline] (a)--(b); \node[fdv] at (a) {}; \node[fdv] at (b) {};
    \node[fdlab] at (-1.2,-1.75) {$p$}; \node[fdlab] at (1.2,-1.75) {$p'$}; \node[fdlab] at (-1.2,1.75) {$k$}; \node[fdlab] at (1.2,1.75) {$k'$};
    \node[fdlab, right] at (0.05,0) {$p + p'$};
    \node[fdlab] at (0,2.5) {$s$-channel};
    \node[fdS] at (0,-2.7) {$\mathcal M \sim \dfrac{1}{s - m_\phi^2}$};
    \node[font=\scriptsize, align=center] at (0,-3.75) {no angle in the denominator};
  \end{scope}
  % t-channel
  \begin{scope}[shift={(5.2,0)}]
    \coordinate (a) at (-0.8,0); \coordinate (b) at (0.8,0);
    \draw[fdl] (-1.5,-1.6)--(a); \draw[fdl] (a)--(-1.5,1.6); \draw[fdl] (1.5,-1.6)--(b); \draw[fdl] (b)--(1.5,1.6);
    \draw[sline] (a)--(b); \node[fdv] at (a) {}; \node[fdv] at (b) {};
    \node[fdlab] at (-1.7,-1.75) {$p$}; \node[fdlab] at (1.7,-1.75) {$p'$}; \node[fdlab] at (-1.7,1.75) {$k$}; \node[fdlab] at (1.7,1.75) {$k'$};
    \node[fdlab, above] at (0,0.05) {$k - p$};
    \node[fdlab] at (0,2.5) {$t$-channel};
    \node[fdS] at (0,-2.7) {$\mathcal M \sim \dfrac{1}{t - m_\phi^2}$};
    \node[font=\scriptsize, align=center] at (0,-3.75) {largest for $\theta \to 0$};
  \end{scope}
  % u-channel
  \begin{scope}[shift={(10.4,0)}]
    \coordinate (a) at (-0.8,0); \coordinate (b) at (0.8,0);
    \draw[fdl] (-1.5,-1.6)--(a); \draw[fdl] (1.5,-1.6)--(b);
    \draw[fdl] (a)--(1.5,1.6);
    \draw[white, line width=4pt] (0.17,0.438)--(-0.17,0.675);
    \draw[fdl] (b)--(-1.5,1.6);
    \draw[sline] (a)--(b); \node[fdv] at (a) {}; \node[fdv] at (b) {};
    \node[fdlab] at (-1.7,-1.75) {$p$}; \node[fdlab] at (1.7,-1.75) {$p'$}; \node[fdlab] at (-1.7,1.75) {$k$}; \node[fdlab] at (1.7,1.75) {$k'$};
    \node[fdlab, below] at (0,-0.05) {$k' - p$};
    \node[fdlab] at (0,2.5) {$u$-channel};
    \node[fdS] at (0,-2.7) {$\mathcal M \sim \dfrac{1}{u - m_\phi^2}$};
    \node[font=\scriptsize, align=center] at (0,-3.75) {largest for $\theta \to \pi$};
    \draw[->, gray] (2.9,-0.9)--(2.9,0.9); \node[font=\scriptsize, gray, right] at (2.9,0) {time};
  \end{scope}
\end{tikzpicture}
